title: Authoritative DNS Zone Compiler
goal: Deliver the authoritative DNS compiler and master-file resolver through this interactive coding session. Incorporate every steering message and staged requirement file, preserve supplied tests, and use only the standard library. Keep the goal active until the user sends `REQUIREMENTS LOCKED`. Then run the full suite, fix failures, call `await goal.complete()`, and respond exactly `DNS ZONE GOAL COMPLETE`.
